$comment: Provenance record for the private local asset store. Every file here was downloaded from the official source links published on https://anatomytool.org/open3dmodel-create and is stored byte-for-byte unchanged. These hashes are the integrity baseline: any derivative must be traceable back to the exact original it came from.
usage: private personal use only. not for redistribution.

source.directory_listing: HTTP 403 - disabled; files reachable by direct link only
source.downloader: PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest, then local unzip; no scraping of the embedded viewer

integrity_policy.rule: Originals are never edited, re-encoded, re-saved, or re-compressed. All optimisation happens on a copy, written to derived/.
integrity_policy.if_a_hash_differs: The file is not the file that was verified. Re-download from the recorded URL, compare the archive hash, and re-audit every mapping that referenced it before using anything.

derived_assets.$comment: Generated by scripts/build-3d-derivatives.ts. Lossless structural trim plus a full texture strip. No geometry is decoded, altered or re-encoded. Each entry names the SHA-256 of the original it came from.

transformations: structural trim: kept only the mapped muscle nodes and their parent group nodes
glTF index tables rewritten to compact the file
all texture, image and sampler references removed; each material keeps its flat baseColorFactor
